description:
Checks the email security of a domain for an agent, paid per call: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and a score, with no account.
The check of `GET /api/email-check`, sold per call to agents, with no account and without the 30 free checks per day before. A request without payment gets the 402 with the price; a paid one gets the audit in the same response, with the payment in `cobranca`. DKIM is looked up in common selectors only; `incomplete: true` means a DNS answer failed. A refused domain, the hourly limit of the service and a failed DNS lookup are not charged.

domain.description: Public domain to check, such as example.com. A subdomain or URL is reduced to its registrable domain.

name: get_api_x402_email_check
title: Get API X402 email check
